gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically-confirmed glioblastoma (WHO Grade IV glioma); tumors situated primarily in the infratentorial compartment will be excluded.
Patients with tumors exhibiting mutated isocitrate dehydrogenase-1 or 2 (IDH-1, 2).

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a two stage, two cohort phase 2 trial of a new blood-brain penetrant PI3K/mTOR inhibitor (paxalisib) combined with a ketogenic diet plus metformin
Subjects will be given daily paxalisib and metformin while also maintaining a ketogenic diet.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This study is for patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma, as well as patients who have recurring glioblastoma.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Change in insulin levels: Evaluated by the mean and standard deviation of values over time
Change in tumor glucose uptake values: Measured by FDG-PET/DCE MRI

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Arm 1: Newly diagnosed MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma:  (interventions: Drug: Paxalisib; Drug: Metformin; Other: Ketogenic Diet)

arms: Arm 1: Newly diagnosed MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma
Arm 2: Recurrent glioblastoma, regardless of methylation status

role_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to assess the safety of Paxalisib while maintaining a ketogenic diet (a high fat, low carbohydrate diet) and Metformin (a drug approved by the Food and Drug Administration to treat type 2 diabetes), and to see what effects it has on glioblastoma.
[EXPERIMENTAL] Arm 2: Recurrent glioblastoma, regardless of methylation status:  (interventions: Drug: Paxalisib; Drug: Metformin; Other: Ketogenic Diet)

arms: Arm 1: Newly diagnosed MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma
Arm 2: Recurrent glioblastoma, regardless of methylation status

source_quote.quote: Demonstrated unmethylated MGMT promotor status confirmed by validated PCR or alternate genomic analysis; subjects with methylated or indeterminate MGMT status that are unwilling, or otherwise unable, to undergo treatment with temozolomide may be enrolled.

arms: Arm 1: Newly diagnosed MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma

source_quote.quote: Patients with tumors exhibiting mutated isocitrate dehydrogenase-1 or 2 (IDH-1, 2).

coder_notes: Two experimental cohorts, both receive paxalisib + metformin + ketogenic diet; no control arm. Metformin is an investigational partner (both drugs are under test), so both experimental_combination. Ketogenic diet is a diet (excluded type), not listed as an agent but named as combination partner. MGMT unmethylated required for the newly diagnosed cohort (with an exception for patients unwilling/unable to take temozolomide) -> enrichment, not candidate-matched. IDH-mutant tumours excluded -> IDH eligibility (wildtype), diagnostic, not matched. Target engagement: insulin levels and tumour glucose uptake (FDG-PET) outcomes are pharmacodynamic for the metabolic/PI3K strategy. Interventions with stated mechanism for metformin not given beyond its diabetes approval. Enrolment requires prior Stupp chemoradiation in cohort 1 (maintenance setting).
